title: Ai is growing so fast it’s hard to know where to put your attention here are the 4 stages of Ai! #ai
description: Ai is growing so fast it’s hard to know where to put your attention here are the 4 stages of Ai! #ai #aitips #learnai #aitiktok
transcript: There are four stages of AI and 90% of people are stuck on stage one. Most people didn't even know stage three and four existed. Watch this. Stage one is chatting and prompting, like when you come over to chat GPT and put in a prompt like, "Please go write me a blog about AI." Stage two is packaging it all up and putting it into a skill. A skill is a step-by-step AI process. For example, on this skill here, you go understand the content. That's step number one. Then you go generate the prompt for the actual image. And then step number three is generating the image working step-by-step. Stage three is taking those packages and then automating them. Like creating a scheduled task that then triggers that skill to run at a certain time every day. And stage four is moving those automations to the cloud so they work without you being at your computer. Now, my challenge for you is just go focus on the stage you're on and figure out what you need to do to get to the next stage. That's how you grow in AI.
